newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan courts jails five students.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan courts jails five students.

text.p: A Moroccan court on Wednesday sentenced five students from an militant Islamic group to five months in jail for "insulting behaviour to state servants that casue bloodshed", said the official Moroccan news agency MAP.
The defendants are law students in Casablanca's university, MAP added. Further details were not given.
Last month a Casablanca court jailed 32 students for up to two years over a student protest in the city to demand improved financial assistance.
In both cases the students belonged to the outlawed Moslem fundamentalist Al-Adl-Wal Ihsane (Justice and Charity) whose leader Abdsalam Yassine is under house arrest.
